versions.changelog: 内容增强：评分新增构成总览与四板块规则速查，补评分手算与破发信号清单示例；资金分配新增分配结果、中签率期望收益换算与资金效率策略对比；限售表新增控股股东维度，补解禁压力解读、处置预案与日历管理；新增上市后交易纪律模块；行业评分表扩充至16个行业；监管动态更新至 2026-09-12

- Added a new "证券监管最新动态" (Latest Securities Regulatory Updates) section summarizing 2026 regulatory changes and their impact on IPO investment strategies.
- Increased SKILL.md version number to 3.0.1.
- No changes to core logic or API—content only update to reflect the latest regulatory environment in China A-share IPOs.

Version 2.0.0 summary:
Enhanced IPO investment strategy analytics with new features for the China A-share market.

- Expanded core capabilities to include IPO calendar, subscription strategy, listing performance analysis, lock-up period management, and capital allocation optimization.
- Introduced detailed multi-factor IPO scoring and recommendation system.
- Added sector “hotness” and market sentiment in performance assessment.
- New modules for lock-up period pressure estimation and risk assessment.
- Supports investors with comprehensive pain point solutions and quick command templates.
- Full bilingual support (English/Chinese) for trigger words and documentation.
